name: BoltLocal
summary: A fork of bolt.diy made one-click: build full-stack apps with any LLM, locally and in plain language.
description: BoltLocal is my fork of bolt.diy, the open-source AI developer workspace, tuned for ease of use: one-click first run, plain-language flows, automatic preview, and autosave. Prompt, run, edit, and deploy full-stack web applications using the LLM of your choice.
